correctness.rationale: Starting from the primary-source two-stage stage equations and order conditions, independently derive the positive-radical q(e), both forcing weights and both stage times. The exact forced two-step error recurrence is solved in closed form, yielding all three limits and the subsequence necessity proof. verify.py replays independent exact-rational and deterministic checks; no infinite result relies on the tests.

value.rationale: A concrete stabilized ODE construction with a tunable numerical damping parameter has a sharp parameter/mesh noncommutation on an entire-polynomial test and exact startup: fixed-parameter second order does not imply consistency when epsilon is co-refined with h. The theorem gives an if-and-only-if safe scaling and exact finite/divergent failures, directly relevant to tuning numerical damping. This is not merely computing a known stability table or highlighting a large stage coordinate.
